# Evan Swope - Digital Portfolio & Creative Direction

> Creative Direction, Brand Strategy, & Apparel B2B Distribution Leadership based in Seattle, WA.

## Executive Summary
Evan Swope is a seasoned Creative Director and Brand Strategist who combines artistic vision (University of Washington BFA in Digital Art & Experimental Media / BA in Communication) with rigorous operational discipline and bottom-line margin tracking. His work spans brand launches, spatial lead generation systems, Odoo ERP migrations, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.

## Key Case Studies & Achievements
- **Apparel B2B & Distribution (`Jan 2025 - Present`)**: Built a spatial lead generation system and automated inbound buyer funnels via MailerLite. Conducted deep COGS analysis to build a distributor SKU catalog with >60% profit margins while migrating fragmented inventory into Odoo ERP. Grew active accounts by 300% (from 2 to 8) in six months and signed the first national retail partner.
- **Brand Launch & D2C Scaling (`May 2019 - Jan 2025`)**: Scaled e-commerce and retail presence across premium national partners.
- **B2B Rebrand & Brand Architecture (`Sept 2018 - May 2019` & `June 2012 - Sept 2018`)**: Engineered cohesive brand identity systems across physical and digital customer touchpoints.

## Philosophy & Core Approach
Creative Direction is a process practiced across stand-up comedy, drag performance, videography, and executive leadership: talking to customers like human beings while maintaining airtight margin and inventory tracking.
